name: 2026-10-09-rental6-skew-gh200
design: design-r6 DESIGN.md corrected by design-r6-review REVIEW.md (a)-(h) (the review wins) and the owner's decisions of 2026-10-09 (1-6 accepted; h kept and labelled SEEN-FITTED)
tool: scorer scripts/scoring/rental6/score_skew.py; predictions r6model.py via reg6.py; histograms scripts/skew_synth.py --draw6
model: model v3 (docs/registered/2026-10-09-rental6-v3-gh200); every cell carries v2, v3, v3_nob, v3_noca, LT3, v3_all and H8 (ms)

histograms.synthetic: SYNTHETIC: rental 5's fitted Zipf / Dirichlet shapes, (kind, param) log-B interpolated to the new treads (Phi: Mixtral's shapes at Phi's B, owner decision 4), one deterministic draw per (model, n, label) at seed 20261010 + 1000 x shape index + 10 n + label index (PT 0, PW 1, DW 2, PW2 3); shuffle seed 20261010

cells.common: R3's tile 32x64x64 w8 s4 at G = 8; NATIVE and SHARED at 9 copies (not vLLM's tile: nothing here is the working bar on vLLM's tile)

pages.C: PW2 (a second PW draw), uniform, balanced

cells.n_stratum: G3's stratum is the tread's rank within its shape
cells.dropped: the permutation cells (owner decision 6); Mixtral's byte page (review (c): lever at most 0.29%)

gates.G1_lock_thermal: R3's G1_lock_thermal PASS and the page's slipped repeat rows (R3 lock_slip_repeats) at most 10% of its repeat rows; a HELD_WITH_SLIPS page within that passes; a page failing it counts in ALL and is dropped in CLEAN (rental 2's rule 3)
gates.repeats: a cell is VALID with at least 6 clean repeats of 9 (clean: not lock-slipped, not drift-excluded); its time and clock are R3's medians over the clean repeats; else the cell is dropped; every slipped repeat is printed with its clock
gates.G2_host_bound: rental 3's registered host rule (T_v3 + F240 >= 0.40 ms on the REGISTERED prediction, F240 0.067551 ms; every rental-6 E1 cell passes it) AND the page's timer flag host_bound; a pair needs both cells
gates.G4_cell_clock: the cell's clean-repeat median clock at least 1705 MHz, else the CELL is dropped (a cell in [1695, 1705) too)
gates.G5_provenance: as rental 5: histogram file sha256, every row's counts_sha256, bincount_ok, the shuffle seed; else the page is NOT SCORED
gates.G3: rental 5's text verbatim, with delta_v3 (the registered uniform / balanced - 1 under v3, 0 on every pair): d_i = T(uniform)/T(balanced) - 1 - delta_v3,i on every valid (shape, page, n, arm), NATIVE and SHARED pooled; equivalence if the 90% cluster-t CI of mean(d), clustered on page (df = pages - 1), lies within +-0.36%; Q = sum (d_i - mean)^2 / (2 x 0.0018^2) against chi2(N - 1); if p < 0.01 the TOST per n-stratum voids only the failing strata's histogram cells, otherwise a failure voids every histogram cell; unseen shapes' token-order prior N(-0.13%, 0.15%)

G3_void_all.rule: OWNER DECISION 2026-10-09: if G3 FAILS and Cochran Q does not reject, every histogram cell is voided and E1-SKEW reads NOT SCORED (rental 5's strict rule kept). E1 is ALSO printed DESCRIPTIVELY on the voided cells (score_skew.py: E1-SKEW 'descriptive', the same statistic and the same bars, labelled 'DESCRIPTIVE, NOT A VERDICT'); it decides nothing and is not the registered E1-SKEW
G3_void_all.risk: the design stated P(G3 passes with Q not rejecting) 0.94, a 6% risk. The build review's simulation (OLMoE at its SEEN rental-5 token-order effect -0.24%, Mixtral and Phi at the N(-0.13%, 0.15%) prior, cell noise sqrt2 x 0.18%, cluster = page, df 8) gives 0.79, and 0.65 to 0.70 under harsher assumptions (OLMoE at -0.30%, or a 0.1% page sd): about 21 to 35% that G3 does not pass cleanly, mostly from OLMoE's -0.24%. Of that, the void-everything branch (the TOST fails, Q does not reject) is about 9 to 14%; the rest is Q rejecting, where the per-stratum TOSTs void only the failing strata
G3_void_all.provenance: build-r6-review g3_sim.py (seed 1, R 100000): registered prior P(pass, Q ok) 0.791, P(Q rejects) 0.122; OLMoE -0.30%: 0.699, 0.166; + page sd 0.1%: 0.646, 0.231

gates.no_report: a page with no report.json is NOT SCORED; cells.csv is never read
gates.views: ALL and CLEAN (rental 2's rule 3, r3common.two_views); the registered verdict is the combination rule's

counter_clock_rule.rule: lock_gate.check_page PASS (nvidia-smi before and after within 15 MHz of the lock, the null kernel and base twin where present), then each cell's SM clock (sm__cycles_elapsed.avg / gpu_time_ns, median over its GEMMs of at least 0.5 ms, else the page's median) in [1640, 1710] MHz; a cell outside is dropped and the page continues
counter_clock_rule.replaces: the unmeetable 1705 MHz cut on counter pages (cycles over duration is a lower bound on the clock)
counter_clock_rule.derivation: the smi-held lock-1710 published counter pages: 3025 of 3033 cells (99.74%) pass; the one off-lock page (the 8x22B floor, smi 1980 MHz) fails check_page and 0 of its 4 cells are in the band
counter_clock_rule.under_lock_control: the published floor pages locked UNDER 1710 are the under-lock negative control: the six floor1005 pages (rental 2 and rental 3: Mixtral tp2 / tp4 / tp8, Qwen2-57B tp8, Granite) and the rental-3 Mixtral tp4 floor1410 page each PASS check_page (their own lock is in force) and give 0 cells in [1640, 1710] MHz (cells at 1004-1005 and 1396-1405 MHz; Granite's cells carry no clock); tests/test_scoring_rental6.py checks it
counter_clock_rule.limits: the under-lock control pages sit 18% and 41% under the lock: the band cannot see a sag under about 4%; it was derived from smi-held pages only, and the smi bracket cannot see a sag inside a capture

E1-SKEW.statistic: e = T_v3 / T_meas - 1 (T_v3 the registered prediction carried to the page's own A: r6model.reprice) over every valid histogram cell (PT PW PW2 DW uniform)
E1-SKEW.rule: HOLDS if rms <= 2%, max |e| <= 5% (the time bar) and |mean e| <= 1% (owner decision 3), each over the POOLED valid cells (all shapes, both arms); per shape and per arm printed; in ALL and CLEAN
E1-SKEW.on_G3_void_all: NOT SCORED; E1 is printed DESCRIPTIVELY on the voided cells, not a verdict (gates.G3_void_all, owner decision 2026-10-09)
E1-SKEW.power: a bar test, not a discriminating test (design 3.2: P(holds) 1.0 under v3 and under v2, H8, v3_all; LT3 0.995)

E1-rivals.rule: rental 5's: a rival is EXCLUDED if its rms on its lever cells is at least 2x v3's there and at least 0.76%; UNDECIDED below 6 surviving lever cells

SKEW-RATIO.statistic: r = T(h) / T(uniform), same page, n and arm; e = r_v3 / r_meas - 1 (A cancels on a block-scan pair)
SKEW-RATIO.rule: rental 5's: HOLDS if rms <= 1.5% and max |e| <= 4%; LT3 and U by the rival rule on their ratio lever cells (LT3 |r_LT3 - r_v3| > 0.75%, U |r_v3 - 1| > 4.5%); LT3 expected UNDECIDED by construction

B-SKEW.statistic: e_B = q_v3 / q_counted - 1 per (cell, GEMM), q = (dram_bytes_read - n x operand) / W_g, on the byte pages under the clock rule
B-SKEW.rule: HOLDS if every PT / PW (cell, GEMM) row has |e_B| <= 5% and their rms <= 3%, POOLED over OLMoE and Phi and both GEMMs EXCEPT OLMoE w1 skewed rows (OPEN-L2SKEW, scored apart); per shape and per GEMM printed; PT and PW only because they are the byte page's only skewed labels

OPEN-L2SKEW.what: OLMoE w1 PT / PW rows, scored apart: OPEN (no model change follows from them)
OPEN-L2SKEW.prior: v3 FAILS here (rental 5 read +8% at n 4 and +25% at n 16; (a) does not move a skewed cell)
OPEN-L2SKEW.rule: v3: HOLDS / FAILS by the B-SKEW bar on these rows; ROWKEY (the rival at 39.5 MiB, priced in byte_predictions): BETTER if every row's |e| <= 5% and its rms <= 0.5 x v3's on the same rows, else NOT BETTER; 60 MiB printed

B-CA.statistic: e_B on the w1 uniform and balanced rows, pooled over the byte pages; per shape printed
B-CA.rule: v3 HOLDS if every row's |e_B| <= 3%; v3_noca (q_pred_v3_noca) is EXCLUDED if its rms is at least 2x v3's and at least 3%

E2-SKEW.statistic: time from counted bytes under v3 (r6model.Pricer.price_counted, the page's A) against the timed page's same (model, n, label, arm) cell (page A)
E2-SKEW.rule: HOLDS if rms <= 2%, worst <= 5% and |mean| <= 1.5%; the DECOMPOSITION ln(T_v3 / T_meas) = ln(T_v3 / T_c) + ln(T_c / T_meas) printed per cell

tests.calibration_line: secondary, descriptive at 3 shapes: below 6 clusters NOT RESOLVED

noise.lever_sigma: 0.18% only (review (h) 13); 0.11% and 0.078% printed in the design

labels.olmoe-1b-7b: BLIND draws, IN-SAMPLE for (b); balanced n <= 9 SEEN
labels.phi-3.5-moe: BLIND; balanced n 2, 4 SEEN replicates; n 12 BLIND

scorer_ambiguities.1 Q1 c15-c9 clause: over the Q1 pages' valid control pairs of the test (copies 9 and 15): mean g(c15) - mean g(c9), |.| <= 1.5 us; no se; both sides needed, else UNDECIDED
scorer_ambiguities.2 se: cluster-robust CR1 on (model, n) clusters, ddof via C / (C - 1); one cluster: iid sd / sqrt(N), ddof 1
scorer_ambiguities.3 g_R: the rival's registered per-pair (S - N)_R - (S - N)_v3, both carried to the page's A, averaged over the same valid pairs
scorer_ambiguities.4 Q1-C se and distance: se_D = sqrt2 x 0.45 us (registered); distance is 1-D on D = x15 - x9
scorer_ambiguities.5 rival positions: functions of the MEASURED x9: CALL D = 0, DEAD D = (ratio - 1) x9
scorer_ambiguities.6 align statistic: median over probe repeats per (arm, n), arm minus native, same page; histogram-independent (S3 test); a histogram cell takes A at its tread
scorer_ambiguities.7 host rule: rental 3's F240 rule on the REGISTERED v3 prediction (T + 0.067551 >= 0.40 ms) AND the page's timer flag; both drop
scorer_ambiguities.8 drift-excluded repeat: not clean (clean = neither lock-slipped nor drift-excluded)
scorer_ambiguities.9 page G1 vs scorer G1: R3's G1 PASS AND slipped rows <= 10%: a page failing either counts in ALL and is dropped in CLEAN
scorer_ambiguities.10 G4 in [1695, 1705): the CELL is dropped; the page stays
scorer_ambiguities.11 B-SKEW scope: PT and PW (the byte page's only skewed labels); per (cell, GEMM) rows, POOLED over shapes and GEMMs except OLMoE w1 skewed (OPEN-L2SKEW); per shape and GEMM printed
scorer_ambiguities.12 B-CA pooling: pooled over the byte pages' w1 uniform / balanced rows; per shape printed
scorer_ambiguities.14 E1 mean: pooled over all valid histogram cells, in each view; the registered verdict is rental 2's rule 3 combination
scorer_ambiguities.16 JetMoE n 4: priced (rental6-q1 predictions); a block-scan control pair in Q1-H
scorer_ambiguities.17 SEEN-table proxy: rental6-v3's align_proxy block (r6model.align_proxy over the published reports)

missing: a missing page's cells are NOT SCORED; the nine skew pages carry nodrop=1 and no shared drop-group
seen_data: the histograms' shapes are SEEN routing statistics
